# `undefined-readvec-destination`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports `readVec` calls passed an array of slice descriptors that is still
undefined, including locally declared descriptor structs containing slices.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`readVec` reads each destination descriptor before writing bytes. Undefined
slice pointers and lengths can cause invalid memory access.

## When it fires

Initialize every destination slice before calling `readVec`. Plain byte arrays
and descriptors initialized before the call are not reported.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn receive(reader: anytype) !void {
    var buffers: [1][]u8 = undefined;
    _ = try reader.readVec(&buffers);
}
```
